method: carry into the MRI template? (Report only, no visual verdict.)
Labels: the per-section sheets labels/push_tracer/<S>/<S>_<class>_bfnative_L2.nii.gz (one blockface slice per histology section, the
tubes-visible registrations of record, current spacing frame), i.e. before the between-section interpolation.
Native side: the brain's own left/right map on its blockface, the atlas regions volume labels/regions_t2_final/<S>_regions_t2.nii.gz
(1 left, 2 right, 3 cerebellum + brainstem, 4 marker tubes = left; made at the nominal spacing, scaled into the current frame per axis
about the world origin, as linc/histology/pieces.regions_scale; label voxels on 0 or 3 take the nearest 1/2/4 voxel).
Template side: the sign of the template's world x (RAS; the template's midline is x = 0) where each section's label lands. Every
template voxel near the carried labels (the sheets' template footprints of record, dilated 2 voxels) is pulled through the chain of
record (route B, MR243 / MR252 / MR256: the R1 of record per paper/numbers/r1_current_2026-10-03.json + the registry's R5; route A, MF191:
bftemplate/d2b/tracer_mf191.chain, the 2b member warp + the s5sym link) and takes, by nearest neighbor, the section and the classes of
the label voxel it lands in (sheets thinner than a template voxel widened along the section axis exactly as tracer_to_template.crop_sheet).
Injection side: the side of the Injection_site class on the native blockface (MR243, MR252, MF191); MR256 has none and takes the side of
its dense terminals (Terminal_dense), recorded as such.
Per section and class: label voxels and the fraction on the injection side, native and template; a section is flagged when the two
fractions differ by > 0.25 with >= 20 voxels in both, and listed as a side outlier when its native fraction differs by > 0.5 from the
median of its labeled neighbours (up to two on each side) for the same class.
Per labeled piece: the tube-landmark record of the same registrations (labels/tube_landmarks/preinp_<S>_native.json: the piece's blockface
piece has a tube; the hole was found in the histology near the mapped tube = the piece's placement and handedness are confirmed).
